user_saw: Nothing visible reported; a remote MCP server sending an impossible date such as February 31 would have had it silently rolled over instead of rejected.
summary: Tightens the mcp-events isoTimestamp check so calendar-impossible dates (for example 2026-02-31) are rejected instead of accepted after Date.parse rolls them over.
reasoning: The lax check (regex plus `Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value))`) shipped unchanged with the plugin in e210870 (#165399); the fix adds stricter validation of untrusted remote input with no linked issue, reported failure or PR describing user impact. That is input-validation hardening rather than a defect anyone hit, so not-a-defect; if counted as a defect it would be never-worked in e210870.
